results.title: Between Us
results.overview: Marina and David, two young artists, no longer feel the same passion that they've had for one another upon the early stages of their relationship. As time goes on, tensions grow and it all reaches a powerful breaking point.

results.title: The Ballad of Judas Priest
results.overview: Witness the 50-year story of Judas Priest. From forging Heavy Metal in the British Steel industry to their rise to Metal Gods.

results.title: The Distance We Drift
results.overview: After nearly a decade apart, two former lovers from Hong Kong unexpectedly meet again in the UK, where they have each built a different life.  Their reunion brings back memories they have tried to move on from, as they slowly reconnect and begin to see how much has changed. Now living far from home, they are forced to face the distance between who they were and who they have become.  Set within the everyday reality of immigrant life, The Distance We Drift is a quiet and intimate story about love, memory, and the way time reshapes people in ways they don’t always realise.

results.title: Bel
results.overview: Tells the story of Beldina Odenyo, the Kenyan Scottish musician, singer and songwriter, who performed under the stage name, Heir of the Cursed as well as working across Scotland’s theatre and poetry communities. After her acclaimed performance at the Scottish Album of the Year Awards in 2021, Bel took her own life. She left behind raw, intimate video diaries and a hard drive full of original songs of great beauty.  This stirring film documents the journey her sister and friends took to release her work posthumously, creating a heartfelt, insightful portrait of a complex, intelligent and profoundly talented young woman.

results.title: The Marine Spirit: A Tale Of The Mami Wata
results.original_title: The Marine Spirit: A Tale Of The Mami Wata
results.overview: The Marine Spirit is based on factual events as told through the eyes of a Nigerian couple. When the young couple find themselves haunted by the spirit of the Mami Wata – an ancient African water deity; they discover the power of faith and prayers.

results.title: Welcome to Dolly's House
results.overview: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

results.title: Roya
results.overview: Roya, an Iranian teacher imprisoned in Tehran’s Evin Prison for her political beliefs, is faced with a choice: make a forced televised confession or remain confined to her three-square-metre cell. As past and present slip out of sequence and exchange places, she moves between inner landscapes and lived experience.

results.title: This Solitude
results.overview: Leo and Lorea have loved one another. Maybe they still do. But something in them has broken. After five years, their relationship is done. He looks after his sick father, trapped between responsibility and an emotional void that weighs him down. She, caught up in poorly-paid jobs and personal crises, tries to get her life back on track without really knowing where to begin. They are two bodies, tired and alone, pierced by their precarious situation, by unresolved issues, by the emotional legacy of a generation who always seem to come late to everything: to love, to stability, to maturity, to serenity, to personal satisfaction.

results.title: Neverman
results.overview: A transgender woman with Alzheimer's moves into a retirement home. As her lucidity wanes, she must confront the challenges of her condition and fight for her identity once more.

results.title: Call Time
results.overview: An aspiring actress, working as a production assistant on an indie film, unexpectedly gets her big break when the lead actress is fired, all while a documentary crew captures the chaos.

results.title: M4M: Motive for Murder
results.overview: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

results.title: Cosmicrew: Ice Planet
results.overview: The second installment of the Cosmicrew movie series! A sudden bolt frees a trio of dinosaurs who once attempted to conquer Earth from their ancient seal. Determined to conquer Earth once again, they begin to freeze the planet step by step, starting with the tropical rainforests along the equator. Receiving orders from the headquarters, the Cosmicrew steps up to defend Earth from their evil scheme.

results.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
results.original_title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
results.overview: The fifth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 4, 2026, at Yamagata Big Wing in Yamagata, Japan.

results.title: AMUCK
results.overview: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

results.title: Batang Paco
results.overview: A timid tattoo artist who transforms into a courageous hero to save his kidnapped daughter from a crime syndicate.

results.title: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
results.overview: Now 93, Martin Luther King Jr.'s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider's view of the Civil Rights Movement.

results.title: Amartha
results.overview: After 25 years, village schoolmates reunite to find themselves in vastly different stages of life. Their journey makes them question whether hard work alone determines destiny, or whether an unseen force called Time shapes every fate.

results.title: Gimme Truth
results.overview: False flags. Forbidden archeology. Chemtrails. Nefarious extraterrestrials. Fake pandemics. Through the intertwined stories of truth-seekers, influencers, and ex-believers, the film explores what draws people into the gravitational pull of conspiracy culture, and what happens when your truth becomes your identity.

results.title: Asambhauuu
results.overview: The story is a metaphor for Yudhishthira and the dog, and explores the idea of dharma. Chintu, a dog, loves his owner, Chintan, like a brother. Chintan, too, loves him with all his heart. When fate puts their love and loyalty to the test, they go to extraordinary lengths to fight for each other.
